title: Session Log: Forge, Seshat, MDA, Podcast, Website

canonical_node.axiom: The session log records decisions and results from a work session, but does not establish any new physical or mathematical law.
definitions: Seshat: Global History Databank used for correlation tests.
chi: A variable representing social complexity, as defined in the Theophysics framework.
SPC: Social complexity measure, as defined in the Theophysics framework.
Forge: A cloud-first build project for a web application.
MDA: Moral Decline of America, a narrative project.
derivation: The log reports that a correlation test between chi and SPC yielded Pearson r = 0.6375, Spearman  = 0.88, Log r = 0.90.
A reduced chi test (dropping SPC-component variables) yielded Pearson r = 0.6935.
A temporal test chi(t) -> SPC(t+1) yielded Pearson r = 0.6283, Spearman  = 0.82.
A delta test chi -> SPC yielded r = -0.124, indicating weak predictive power.
A collapse prediction test showed a 3.3 base rate improvement (base rate 2.97%, conditional on sharp chi drop: 9.86%).
canonical_node.action: The system should treat the reported correlations as provisional empirical findings, not as established laws. It should await further validation (e.g., AUC tests) before considering them as evidence for the Theophysics framework.
boundary: This document does not provide a formal proof or derivation of the correlations.
It does not establish causality between chi and SPC.
It does not validate the Theophysics framework as a whole.

plain_summary: This session log reports on various project activities, including a correlation test between social complexity (chi) and SPC using the Seshat database. The results show moderate to strong correlations, but the document does not provide a formal proof or establish causality. The log also covers decisions on Forge, MDA, podcast, and website architecture. The overall status is that the empirical findings are provisional and require further validation.
